_README: Triaged, benign title divergences between a sprint-plan heading and the
Why this file exists: the crosswalk accumulates outcomes over time (a title
grows '- rec: keep v3' once the work lands) while plan headings stay as
written at sprint start. That benign drift produced enough noise to hide a
REAL key reuse (AINOS3-30, Sprint 27) for ten days. Acknowledging the benign
cases keeps the noise floor at zero so a real one is visible immediately.
Add an entry ONLY after confirming the plan and the crosswalk describe the
SAME work. If they describe different work the key has been reused - split
the new work under its own slug instead of acknowledging it here.
